verdict.rationale: Grok Build's docs list "Explain this repo." and "@src/main.rs Walk me through this file." as recommended first prompts. Plan mode has the agent explore the codebase and draft a plan before editing, which maps directly to finding where to start making changes. Supporting features include subagents that return summaries and AGENTS.md architecture notes the agent follows. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how the agent maps or indexes repo structure (e.g., dependency/architecture views), hands-on or independent corroboration of codebase-explanation quality.
